# proxmox_schedule_analyze (Data Source)

Analyzes a calendar schedule through `/cluster/jobs/schedule-analyze`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_schedule_analyze" "a" {
  schedule   = "*-*-* 03:00"
  iterations = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `schedule` (String) Calendar event specification.

### Optional

- `iterations` (Number) Number of results, default 10.
- `starttime` (Number) Start epoch.

### Read-Only

- `points` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--points))

<a id="nestedatt--points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `points`

Read-Only:

- `timestamp` (Number)
- `utc` (String)
